context: Kenji attends a film screening; meets Aoi and shares thoughts.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Ken-chan, that film was really something. The visuals especially.
lines.jp: けんちゃん、映像、すごかったね。

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Yeah. The cinematography was really professional. You could tell.
lines.jp: 監督の描写、本格的やった。

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: I wonder where they filmed it?
lines.jp: 撮影、どこでしたんだろう?

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Out in the countryside somewhere. They used the landscape really well — it became part of the story.
lines.jp: 地方の自然、映画に活かしてた。

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: And the way the audience reacted. It was so genuine.
lines.jp: 客席の反応、温かかった。

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Yeah. The kind of thing that stays with you.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: I'd love to see more films like that.
lines.jp: また、こういう作品観たい。
